study.label: Study title
study.help: The title of the publication, or of the study if it is unpublished.
study.example: Plasma lipidome of healthy adults and patients with type 2 diabetes

study.label: Study description
study.help: Two to five sentences: aim, cohort or samples, design. Datasets are described on the Datasets sheet.
study.example: Targeted plasma lipidomics of 40 adults (20 with type 2 diabetes, 20 controls), measured by RP-LC-MS/MS in positive and negative mode.

study.label: Study type
study.help: Lipidome study (many classes), technical study (method development, few classes), reference material study, or ring trial study (several laboratories measure the same samples; one dataset per laboratory, named in Measuring laboratory).

study.label: Publication DOI
study.help: DOI of the article that reports these data, starting with 10. Write 'unpublished' and send us the manuscript if there is none yet.

study.label: Related publication DOIs
study.help: Companion papers or the methods paper, separated by ';'.

study.label: PubMed ID
study.help: PMID of the article, if it has one.

study.label: Data licence
study.help: Licence for the data you submit. CC-BY-4.0 is recommended; other licences are checked by the curators (P21). Proprietary: LipidCompass may display the data, but neither the submissions repository nor LipidCompass makes them available for download by default (access-controlled data, e.g. sensitive data); describe the access conditions below.

study.label: Data access conditions
study.help: Only for Proprietary data: who may get access to the data, and how (contact, data access committee, agreement).

study.label: Embargo until
study.help: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) before which the data must not be published, e.g. the expected publication date.

study.label: Raw data repository links
study.help: Links to the raw data, e.g. MetaboLights, Metabolomics Workbench or Zenodo, separated by ';'.

study.label: Lipidomics Minimal Reporting Checklist DOI
study.help: DOI or URL of your completed Lipidomics Standards Initiative reporting checklist.

study.label: Lipid nomenclature used
study.help: How lipid names on the quantities sheets are written. Shorthand 2020 (Liebisch et al.) is preferred.

study.label: Comments for the curators
study.help: Anything the curators should know (special sample types, data processing, deviations from the template).

study.label: LipidCompass study id
study.help: Assigned by the curators (LCS-XXXXX). Leave empty.

contacts.label: Affiliation
contacts.example: Institute of Example Lipidomics, Example University, Example City, Country

contacts.label: Role
contacts.help: At least one corresponding author and one submitter (can be the same person).

datasets.label: Dataset id
datasets.help: Short id of your choice, e.g. D1, D2. One dataset = consecutive measurements of one sample set with one method; positive and negative mode, different platforms, labs or cohorts are separate datasets.

datasets.label: Dataset title
datasets.help: What this dataset is: matrix, method, mode, lab or cohort.

datasets.label: Dataset description
datasets.example: 40 plasma samples, RP-LC-MS/MS on a Q Exactive in positive mode; class-specific internal standards.
datasets.help: Samples, method and anything that sets this dataset apart from the others.

datasets.label: Dataset content
datasets.help: Individual samples, or summary statistics per group (means / medians) when per-sample data are not available (P4, B21).

datasets.label: Measuring laboratory
datasets.help: Laboratory that measured this dataset; needed when datasets of the study come from different labs or sites.

datasets.label: Quantities sheet
datasets.help: Name of the sheet with this dataset's quantities (Q_<dataset id>). Copy a Q_ sheet for every further dataset.

datasets.label: Quantities layout
datasets.help: How the quantities sheet is arranged: samples in rows and lipids in columns, or lipids in rows and samples in columns (as many tools export). Choose per dataset.

datasets.label: Lipid extraction
datasets.help: Extraction protocol; add details in 'Sample preparation details'.

datasets.label: Sample preparation details
datasets.example: 20 uL plasma; SPLASH LIPIDOMIX added before extraction; dried under nitrogen, reconstituted in 100 uL methanol.
datasets.help: Volumes, internal standards, derivatisation, storage.

datasets.label: Separation
datasets.help: Chromatography type, or direct infusion.

datasets.label: Column
datasets.example: Waters Acquity UPLC BEH C18, 2.1 x 100 mm, 1.7 um
datasets.help: Commercial column name and dimensions.

datasets.label: Separation details
datasets.example: A: ACN/H2O 60:40, B: IPA/ACN 90:10, both 10 mM ammonium formate; 20 min gradient
datasets.help: Solvents, gradient, flow.

datasets.label: Mass spectrometer
datasets.help: Commercial instrument model.

datasets.label: Ion source
datasets.help: Ionisation method.

datasets.label: Mass analyzer
datasets.help: Analyzer(s) used for the reported data.

datasets.label: Detector
datasets.help: Detector type (Orbitrap instruments: inductive detector).

datasets.label: Scan polarity
datasets.help: Polarity of the reported data; both polarities in one dataset are allowed.

datasets.label: Acquisition mode
datasets.help: DDA, DIA, SRM/MRM, PRM, precursor/neutral loss scans, or MS1 only.

datasets.label: Fragmentation (dissociation) method
datasets.help: How ions were fragmented, e.g. CID, or HCD (= beam-type CID). Not the acquisition mode.

datasets.label: Acquisition software
datasets.help: Instrument control software; its version goes in the next column.

datasets.label: Acquisition software version
datasets.help: Version of the acquisition software, e.g. 4.1. Leave empty if unknown (the curators get a warning).

datasets.label: Identification / quantification software
datasets.help: Software for identification and quantification; its version goes in the next column.

datasets.label: Identification / quantification software version
datasets.help: Version of the identification / quantification software, e.g. 4.2. Leave empty if unknown (the curators get a warning).

datasets.label: Identification database / library
datasets.help: Database, spectral library or rule set used for identification.

datasets.label: Identification confidence measure
datasets.help: The score that supports identifications.

datasets.label: Identification reliability scheme
datasets.help: The scheme of the per-lipid levels on the Lipids sheet (MSI levels 1-4).

datasets.label: Quantification method
datasets.help: Absolute only for calibrated concentrations or amounts; IS-normalised ratios and raw intensities are relative (P6).

datasets.label: Quantification unit
datasets.help: Unit of the numbers on the quantities sheet. nmol/mL = umol/L; pmol/mL = nmol/L. Raw intensities: number of detector counts.

datasets.label: What the numbers are
datasets.help: Concentrations, normalised ratios or raw intensities (B10).

datasets.label: Internal standards
datasets.example: SPLASH LIPIDOMIX (Avanti 330707), one standard per class
datasets.help: Internal standard mix and how it was used for normalisation. If the quantities include internal standards, mark them on the Lipids sheet.

datasets.label: Missing values
datasets.example: empty cell = not detected or not measured
datasets.help: How missing and below-LoD values are written (P12: empty = null).

datasets.label: Raw data of this dataset
datasets.help: Link to this dataset's raw files, if different from the study's repository link.

datasets.label: Comments
datasets.help: Anything special about this dataset.

samples.label: Sample name
samples.help: Unique name; exactly as in column A of the quantities sheets. A sample measured in several datasets is listed once.

samples.label: Sample type
samples.help: Individual sample, pooled sample, QC, blank or reference material (B21, B23.7).

samples.label: Tissue / matrix
samples.help: As stated in the Methods: EDTA/heparin/citrate tubes = plasma, clotted = serum (P2). BTO terms are preferred; UBERON terms (listed after the BTO terms) are accepted.

samples.label: Disease
samples.help: Disease of the donor; controls: Control Group (P10). NCIT terms are preferred; Disease Ontology (DOID) terms (listed after the NCIT terms) are accepted.

samples.label: Age (years)
samples.help: Age at sampling in years (use a factor column for other units).

samples.label: Sample description
samples.help: Free text, e.g. how a pooled sample was made.

factors.label: Factor (column name)
factors.help: A Samples column (sex, age, disease) or the name of a factor column added on the Samples sheet.

factors.label: Factor term
factors.help: What the factor is, as a CV term.

factors.label: Defines the study groups
factors.help: 'yes' for the factors the paper compares (become study variables); 'no' for covariates (B18).

lipids.label: Dataset id
lipids.help: Dataset the lipid column belongs to.

lipids.label: Lipid name
lipids.help: Exactly as on the quantities sheet (row 2, or column A with lipids in rows).

lipids.label: Sum formula (neutral)
lipids.help: Sum formula of the neutral lipid (no adduct), if you have it. The curators check it against the lipid name.

lipids.label: Internal standard?
lipids.help: 'yes' for internal standards that are part of the quantities (kept and annotated, P6). If your lab removed them after quantification, there is nothing to mark.

lipids.label: Identification level
lipids.help: Per-lipid level of the scheme on the Datasets sheet (MSI 1-4). Without a level, a lipid name in shorthand notation counts as level 3.

lipids.label: Comment
lipids.help: E.g. isomers summed, co-eluting species, sterol analyte (P7, P8).
